future_check: Reject any new axis unless observe_overrides can recover it exactly across both boundaries and all difficulty bands.
rationale: The legacy surface exposed aliases, constants, and ignored helpful modes, expanding the override matrix to 294 cases and 26,460 draws without adding observable variation. The repaired surface has five exact axes and 53 cases.
summary: AXES must remain a small set of exact values recoverable from the returned grid.

future_check: Widen only with new canonical or independently approved semantic evidence; preserve at least 25% canonical-envelope support and all rival refutations.
rationale: Canonical inputs are 8..10 by 10..12 with 2..3 colors, max component count 2..3, and component sizes 1..3. Anchoring there raises canonical-envelope support from 2/60 to 60/60, but it does not train extrapolation to seven colors or six components.
summary: The repaired distribution deliberately narrows the legacy 30x30/7-color surface to the demonstrated canonical scale.

future_check: After any layout or axis-range change, re-run the full written override matrix and assert every accepted draw realizes every keyed exact axis.
rationale: The minimum 8x10 canvas supplies nine isolated slots while the repaired contract needs at most six components. This removes fallback placement and silent component loss while preserving 4-connectivity and one-cell gaps.
summary: Use isolated 2x2 component slots on a three-cell lattice so every requested component is placed exactly.

future_check: Keep at least one multi-cell component mandatory and retain the cell-count rival in lesson_identifiable.
rationale: Every lawful draw contains both a singleton and a multi-cell component, and 467/600 main-census draws mix component sizes within a color. The named cell-count rival is checked by lesson_identifiable and rejected in all 12 materialized lessons.
summary: The lesson counts connected components, not colored cells.

future_check: Re-run exact selected-source sync plus execution parity after any Racket authority or RULE_HASH edit.
rationale: Canonical program_solution, selected target_code, and archival raw_code are byte-exact synchronized and solve all 5 canonical pairs. The defects were in generator metadata and distribution, so a Racket rewrite would add source churn without semantic benefit.
summary: Keep the canonical Racket rule unchanged and pin its normalized hash in the generator.

future_check: Require spatial_order_differs_from_numeric_order to remain 100% after any component-shape or record-order refactor.
rationale: Each color first occupies an early slot in descending color order, with the first component forced to contain the slot top-left cell. The strict main census and disjoint stability census both observe the disagreement in 600/600 draws.
summary: Output rows are ordered by ascending numeric color, not first spatial appearance.
